- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18536-18537 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: If the label rollback fails, the issue stays in `ai:planning` indefinitely and has no re-plan marker.
  WHY: `_plan_auto_approval_gate` only runs for `ai:awaiting-approval`, so an issue left in `ai:planning` without the marker is never re-planned and never re-enters the gate; the reviewer gave no severity, so medium is a default; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 called this an accepted residual risk, and minimax_minimax-m3 noted it needs a triple failure and that the retrigger_plan arm recovers it.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18541-18548 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The confirmation re-read GET does not use `--paginate`.
  WHY: If more than 100 comments fall inside the 10-minute `gate_replan_since` window, the marker can sit on a later page and be missed, which causes a wrong rollback and loses the one automatic re-plan; the reviewer gave no severity, so medium is a default; minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 raised the same `--paginate` point only as a non-defect hardening suggestion.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18541-18559 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: If the `/answer` POST was accepted but its response was lost, a failed confirmation GET leaves `gate_replan_landed=false`, and the code rolls the issue back to `ai:awaiting-approval`.
  WHY: The marker may already be on the issue, so the planning workflow skips (the issue no longer has `ai:planning`) and the next poll sees the marker and does not retry; the eligible hold goes to the human hold-notice path instead (the reviewer rated this NIT, mapped to low); z-ai_glm-5_3-flash and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 judged this the documented safe fallback, not a defect.

  FIX: track the gh_retry read result in a local such as gate_replan_read="failed"/"no_marker", checking first that the name is unused, and append `read=${gate_replan_read}` to the log line; 3-4 lines.

  ISSUE: without `date -d`, `since` is dropped and the read returns only the oldest 100 comments, so the marker can be missed and the code rolls back; the runners are Ubuntu, so this does not happen in CI today.
  FIX: leave as is, or add `--paginate` when gate_replan_since is empty; 1-2 lines.
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
